name: Neutral slave-trade exclusion
description: An ordinary neutral player cannot buy slaves; refusal preserves every settlement input.

tests.name: Rig the ordinary player as neutral-aligned

data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment=0 WHERE name='neutral_slave_buyer'
SELECT port_id,sector_id FROM ports WHERE sector_id>10 ORDER BY port_id LIMIT 1

tests.name: Rig neutral player at the unprotected port sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{neutral_slave_sector_id} WHERE name='neutral_slave_buyer'

tests.name: Rig active ship at the neutral player's port sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{neutral_slave_sector_id} WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='neutral_slave_buyer')

tests.name: Configure the selected port to sell one slave unit

data.sql: DELETE FROM port_trade WHERE port_id=@{neutral_slave_port_id} AND commodity='SLV'

tests.name: Seed slave sale mode and stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price,last_updated_ts) VALUES('port',@{neutral_slave_port_id},'SLV',10,1000,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=10,price=1000

tests.name: Capture neutral buyer balances and stock before purchase attempt

data.sql: SELECT p.credits,t.turns_remaining,COALESCE(c.quantity,0),(SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{neutral_slave_port_id} AND commodity_code='SLV') FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id LEFT JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='SLV' WHERE p.name='neutral_slave_buyer'

tests.name: Neutral player is refused when buying slaves
Neutral slave-buy refusal preserves credits turns cargo and port stock

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.credits=@{neutral_slave_credits} AND t.turns_remaining=@{neutral_slave_turns} AND COALESCE(c.quantity,0)=@{neutral_slave_cargo} AND (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{neutral_slave_port_id} AND commodity_code='SLV')=@{neutral_slave_stock} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id LEFT JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='SLV' WHERE p.name='neutral_slave_buyer'
